text: The `-n, --newstore` command line option has been renamed to `-m, --make` and has no parameters. There is a new `-n, --net` option that requires a network token  (`mainnet`, `testnet3`, `testnet4`, `regtest`, `signet`). The store directory default name is changed from `bitcoin` to the token, `mainnet` by default, and all relevant config settings are also adjusted to correspond to the selected network. A configured `bitcoin.network=<token>` is overridden by the `--net=<token>` value, but otherwise controls the network defaults. Overrides are logged, as they are with any restart where stored settings don't match configured settings.
